name: tong-skills
title_zh: 11 个技能打包上架，拆开是工具箱合上是瑞士军刀
tagline_zh: 别人卖单个技能，你一次拿 11 个。不用挨个翻仓库、比兼容、试错，装一个包等于逛完整个货架，还省下挑花眼的时间。
tagline_en: Why buy one when you can grab 11? Skip the shelf-hopping, compatibility checks, and trial runs. One install.
why_zh: 它不赌单个技能爆不爆，而是用 11 个覆盖高频场景，让你按需取用。机制上像订阅制：先全给，再让你挑。
why_en: It hedges against single-skill flops by covering 11 common use cases. Subscription-style: give everything upfront, let you pick.
limit_zh: 这是合集不是单个技能，装完得自己逐个试哪个顺手。11 个里可能只有 3 个对你有用，其余 8 个占着列表位置。
limit_en: It's a bundle, not a single skill. You'll need to test each of the 11 to find your 3 keepers; the other 8 clutter your list until manually removed.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 11 skills in one pack: a toolbox that folds into a Swiss.
